evidence.tests: 15 passed (npx vitest run, rerun by the grader): 12 prior scenarios, the legitimate acct-2/500/memo call allowed once, a memo-attached call above the ceiling denied, and a memo changed after presentation denied by proof-of-possession
evidence.notes: Second run, against the revised skill. Triage note identified the closed-world unknown-field rejection of memo at the holder's present() before the gateway, classified the cause as policy, and confirmed the root cause by observing the predicted failures before changing the policy. In this project recipient and amount are issuance-time parameters and the fixture already admitted acct-2 within its ceiling, so neither was widened. Fix: memo named with wildcard() in the issued policy and carried through present(), verify(), and the effect, which now records it on the ledger; the report explicitly ranks this as the last-resort rung, says why no finite set or range fits free text, and states that the argument must reach the effect. Verifier trusted roots, PoP, closed-world mode, TTL, and depth unchanged. Compared with the first run, the revised rank 1 produced the missing justification and made the effect consume the argument; the run chose recording over dropping, which the prompt leaves open. Its error text quoted the pre-#709 SDK hint recommending pattern('*'); the run did not follow that suggestion.
